findings: N2 preserves pooled outcome distribution exactly by construction.
N2 preserves each date's cross-sectional outcome multiset exactly.
N2 redistributes stock-specific drift and volatility across recipient feature streams.
Example: real NVDA forward-path std 0.03158 vs N2 recipient std 0.01950; real JNJ 0.01188 vs N2 0.01922.
The first four-arm gate was not sample-comparable: real/N1/N3 used each ticker's own last 2500 eligible rows, while N2 used the common aligned last 2500 dates.
Therefore the observed N2 advantage cannot be interpreted as a valid null-gate failure until all arms use the identical aligned date panel.

required_repair.controller_fix: Use identical common aligned dates/features/outcomes for real, N1, N2 and N3 arms before null transformation.
required_repair.n2_followup: After sample alignment, test whether cross-sectional permutation should be bucketed to preserve stock/sector/liquidity/volatility heterogeneity; do not decide from the contaminated comparison.
